IDENT.title: Multicast dataset synchronization and agent negotiation in distributed manufacturing control systems

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: Multi agent systems represent an elegant approach for the control architecture of manufacturing systems.

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: there are four resource agents, a mediator agent and from one to four active WIP agents

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: it has a local copy of the common dataset

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: The common dataset contains real time information about all active products and resources at any given time.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: The solution [next operation and allocated resource] with the higher score is proposed by the agent.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: If this time is high and the system has a high number of agents, the token waiting time can grow exponentially.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: The common dataset synchronization is transparent for the agent

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: The pilot implementation is developed using JADE multi agent platform and JGroups messaging framework

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: it contains the operation scheduling and the resource allocations done in real time up to the current time moment

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Common dataset holds operation scheduling, resource allocations so far, execution status, resource status and current work item.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: for each shop floor resource, the common dataset contains its status, the current work item in execution, the current operation

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: The common dataset assures the ability to make the decision on global system data as all other agents data is available

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: the common dataset provides a complete view of the entire shop floor

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: the dataset is synchronized automatically across all agents

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: common dataset synchronized across all entities, coherent access of the common dataset, transaction support, high-performance for real time information access

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: implemented using FIPA INFORM messages passed between the JADE agents

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: If a simple majority of the agents accept the solution based on the threshold configured, then the solution is accepted

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: The transmission is configured to use UDP multicast, each message being transmitted to all cluster members.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_analyzed.evidence_quote: Fig. 9. Messages per second with various dataset sizes

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_metric.value: messages per second and data rate per second vs message size (5k-20k) and cluster size (4,8,10)
D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_metric.evidence_quote: Fig. 10 illustrates the data transmission rate with various message sizes for 4, 8 and 10 cluster members

D_COMMUNICATION__handles_comm_failure.evidence_quote: JGroups also provides the possibility to detect failed cluster members.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: NetLogo for abstract representation of the simulation system

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: some important metrics from the operational perspective are those that reflect the network communications

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: it can signal resource breakdown scenario even when the resource is not reachable

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: the JGroups cluster will have typically nine active members at any time moments

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: at some point in the assembly process, the product can continue by mounting Part_A or Part_B

H_STANDARDS__interoperability_claimed.evidence_quote: can be used with any multi agent Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) implementation

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: When operating in decentralized mode, each WIP agent must handle two types of problems at each step: operation sequencing and resource allocation.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Uses a globally replicated common dataset with token locking and majority voting instead of model-based capability discovery; no formal model of agent knowledge.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: There is one token that can be assigned to one agent at a time.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Locking mechanism required for reads and writes so data is not outdated.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: the locking mechanism is required for both read and writes, as data can become outdated without it

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: the OS/WIP agents are joining the cluster when they enter the production line and exit the cluster when the execution is completed
